## View Txt v0.1.2

The first public build of a small IntelliJ plugin for one specific annoyance: you are writing code that follows a specification, and every few lines you switch tabs to re-read the bit of the spec you are implementing. View Txt puts that file in a floating page at your caret instead — triple-tap the trigger key, read, keep typing, and the page you stopped on is still there later.

## New

### Reading without leaving the editor

- Triple-tapping the trigger key (default `/`, three presses within two seconds) opens the registered text file as a popup at the caret. `Tools → Show File Content Popup` does the same thing through the same path and index.
- The popup is placed below-right of the caret at a fixed offset; near a screen edge it flips to the other side and is clamped on screen, and it follows the editor when you scroll.
- The mouse wheel turns pages — down for the next, up for the previous. `Esc` or a click outside closes it.
- Each page is ten lines of 10–24 characters, so pages read like prose instead of a fixed grid; the step list is remembered, so paging back lands exactly on the previous boundary rather than a recomputed approximation.
- A greyed `...` line marks that more content follows. Lines are drawn in the IDE's own editor scheme font and size, each carrying its file-type icon.

### Settings that survive

- The tool window (`view-txt setting`) holds the file path (typed or chosen with 浏览), the trigger key, the start index and the popup size; 保存路径 and 设置快捷键 apply them, and 刷新 re-reads the index the popup has advanced to.
- Twelve trigger keys are offered: `/`, `.`, `,`, `;`, `'`, `` ` ``, `-`, `=`, `[`, `]` and `\`, stored as a `KeyEvent` key code.
- Saving a new file path resets the index to 0 — an index from another file would land in the middle of unrelated text.
- Width and height are editable, and the popup itself is resizable and movable with the mouse.

### State and compatibility

- Everything is persisted per project through `FileStateService` into `viewTxt.xml` under `.idea/`: `lastSelectedFilePath`, `lastContentPosition`, `popupShortcut`, `popupWidth`, `popupHeight`. The names are treated as a stable interface, because renaming any of them invalidates existing configurations.
- The page you stopped on survives closing the popup, switching files in the project, and restarting the IDE.
- This build targets **IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+** (`sinceBuild = 241`) and compiles to Java 17 bytecode, so it installs on the 2024.1 line and not only on the newest IDE.
- The plugin ships a vector icon (`META-INF/pluginIcon.svg`) derived from the project logo: a white rounded tile with a document and a magnifier.

## Notes

- Built with Kotlin 2.1 and the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.10; `./gradlew buildPlugin` produces the installable ZIP.
- The plugin reads the file as plain text — it is a reading aid, not an editor, so nothing is ever written back to the file it shows.
